**Engineer memory and context:**
Build retrieval, persistent memory, context compression, and management systems that allow agents to work effectively across long tasks and conversations.

**Optimize inference:**
Experiment with quantization, speculative decoding, and inference-time techniques to improve model quality, speed, and efficiency on local hardware.

**Model optimization:**
Familiarity with quantization, efficient inference, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and compute.

**Experience with post-training:**
Familiarity with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, distillation, or other techniques for improving model behavior.

You enjoy reading papers, implementing new ideas, and turning research into working software.

**Independence:**
You take ownership of ambiguous problems, move quickly, and thrive in an experimental environment.
